title: Approve: first-unattended-run waits for the three next-run Actions (press BEFORE the next-run Grant)
problem: first-unattended-run is queued first and is outside the next-run Grant's scope, and nothing makes it wait for the three in-scope Actions. When one of them completes, the pointer advances onto first-unattended-run, and the Active scheduler then re-points to the next in-scope Action with an unreviewed local commit on main that lands in the next candidate's base and breaks that PR's 'touches only' criterion (Process Critic pre-mortem, NO-GO).
desired_effect: Accept Agent Ask amend-first-unattended-run-depends-on-next-run-actions-20261019 and change only first-unattended-run's depends_on, adding test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion, refresh-decision-0130-status-and-1559-fake and guard-repair-gate-upsert-role to its three existing dependencies (and its source line). Its title, next action, criteria and status, every other Action, the queue order and both current_action pointers stay unchanged. Completing each in-scope Action then advances the pointer to the next in-scope Action inside that Action's own PR; first-unattended-run becomes eligible only after all three are done.

planUnchanged.milestone: Arcadia runs production unattended on its own repository on the Claude provider: the worker launches a Session, preserves a reviewed PR, merges it through the PR when it is not authority-adjacent, and continues to the next Action within a spend bound, with operator touches limited to authority-adjacent merges.

success.effect: first-unattended-run now depends on the three next-run Actions and is not eligible until they are done. The pointer still names first-unattended-run.
